note: The CORE voice lines (owner decision 2026-10-18). English and the languages in `full` (German, owner decision 2026-10-21) are voiced in full; every other voiced language (fr, es, pt, ru, ja, zh) ships ONLY these lines, the rest stay text-only (silent bubble). Single source of truth: tools/voice/core.mjs, the todo, the tests and `voice:gen --lang` read it. A line is core when its id (without the __f girl-hero suffix) matches a pattern or is listed in `include`, and is not in `exclude`; the __f twin follows its base line. Edit here, then run `pnpm voice:script`.
